# Tear-out row 1's main-window check reds CI on an engine race

Owned by Vega, the author of #21380: the main-window arm that #21380 added to row 1 reds `e2e-engine (15/15)` on four PRs in four hours, an outside contributor's among them.

## Context

`test/playwright/e2e/colors/tearOutMatrix.spec.mjs:142` (row 1) failed on #21410, #21412, #21436 and #21445 after #21380 merged on 19 Nov at 01:52Z. Each went green on rerun.

```
Error: the main window after the drop: no chart text leaves its svg
+   "\"Occurrences in grid cells\" at 47,543 17×175, its svg at 34,527 1212×160",
```

## The Problem

The arm catches a real engine race, #21455: in a failing run the Grid pane comes back to the main window shortly after pointer-up while its popup stays open, and the chart-text check then reads the three-pane layout, where the bar chart cuts its own axis title. The failing job and its green rerun log the same receipt (`acquiredAtStep: 8`), and `dev` passed 10 of 10 local runs, so the gesture is not what varies.

**Correction (19 Nov 07:13Z):** this ticket first blamed row 1's release point, inside the window near x 917. Moving the release outside did not help: 1 of 10 local runs failed the same way, and its trace shows a re-entry before the release that the extra move caused.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: n/a — no existing behavior is called wrong here; the engine defect is #21455.

- Row 1's main-window arm is two calls, `expectPanesRefill(page, …)` and `expectChartTextInside(page, …)`, after the popup's moments.

## The Fix

Row 1 drops its main-window arm until #21455 fixes the race; #21455's AC-3 brings it back. The popup's moments stay.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Row 1 asserts nothing about the main window after the drop.
- [ ] AC-2: The spec passes 10 of 10 local runs (`--repeat-each=10`).

## Out of Scope

- The race: #21455.
- The colors bar chart cutting its axis title at 1280 × 720 with three panes (defect-note, 18 Nov).

## Avoided Traps

- Seeding the colors data: the text that overflows is the bar chart's axis title, not a data label.
- Moving the release outside the window: it added a re-entry path and fixed nothing.
